title: ononis viscosa var. pitardii
intro: Ononis viscosa var. pitardii, commonly known as sticky restharrow, is a plant species in the family Fabaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions such as fever, digestive issues, and skin problems. The therapeutic actions of sticky restharrow are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of Ononis viscosa var. pitardii include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
